title: Lope de Vega, La dama boba: edición crítica y archivo digital
author: Lope de Vega
institution: PROLOPE (Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona) and CRR-MM, Università di Bologna; edited by Marco Presotto
license_note: Per the project's 'Recursos y licencias' section: the TEI/XML critical edition is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; the PDF of the critical edition is CC BY-NC-ND 3.0; the facsimiles from the Biblioteca Nacional de España are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
notes: Critical edition of one play, La dama boba (autograph dated 1613, first printed 1617), with a variant apparatus and an archive that shows facsimile and transcription of the three witnesses (autograph, a contemporary copy, the 1617 printed Parte XI). The downloadable TEI/XML (edicion_critica.xml) holds the critical text with the apparatus. Published 2015 (ISBN 9788898010257, doi 10.6092/UNIBO/LADAMABOBA); the server reports files changed on 10 January 2025.
